senses.definition_en: hunting-and-gathering

examples.english: In some prehistoric cultures, the women, like the men, have assumed a particular cultural role in hunter-gatherer societies; the women almost always are the ones that gather the plant products, while the men supply the meat by hunting.
examples.text: En algunas culturas desde la prehistoria, las mujeres, como los hombres, han asumido un papel cultural particular en sociedades de cazarecolección; las mujeres casi siempre eran las que recogían los productos vegetales mientras que los hombres suministraban la carne mediante la caza.
examples.translation: In some prehistoric cultures, the women, like the men, have assumed a particular cultural role in hunter-gatherer societies; the women almost always are the ones that gather the plant products, while the men supply the meat by hunting.
